name: 21090 · Linthicum, MD
findings: ZIP 21090 (Linthicum) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21090 (Linthicum) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21090 (Linthicum) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).
